section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a factor structure analysis of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) conducted on a sample of Black women. The authors performed an exploratory factor analysis (EFA) that initially suggested two factors, but upon closer examination, a unidimensional structure was deemed most appropriate and confirmed through confirmatory factor analysis (CFA). The CFA model showed adequate fit (χ² = 185.02, df = 65, CFI = .94, SRMR = .05, RMSEA = .09), with all factor loadings ranging from .42 to .91, supporting the unidimensional nature of the BAS measure in this population.
